brief:
Israeli occupation forces detained a group of young men at the entrance to Jenin, Shehab Wire reported. No immediate details were provided about the number of detainees or the reasons for the operation.

The detention occurred at a location that has been a frequent flashpoint for Israeli military activity in the West Bank. Jenin has witnessed repeated clashes and security operations by Israeli forces over recent months. The city remains a focal point of tension in the occupied territory, with regular confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli military personnel stationed in and around the area.
